A MILESTONE FOR FOF A New Chapter in Football Excellence
This year, FOF reaches a significant milestone by
welcoming Paris Saint-Germain as a
participating team, marking an important step in
the tournament’s development and international
positioning. The presence of one of the world’s
most recognized football clubs brings increased
visibility and prestige, reinforcing FOF’s ambition
to establish itself as a professional and
internationally connected football platform.
FOF X PARIS SAINT-GERMAIN
RAISING COMPETITIVE &
PROFESSIONAL
STANDARDS
A MILESTBUILDING THE FUTURE OF
FOFONE FOR FOF
The participation of PSG contributes to elevating
the competitive level and sporting standards of
the tournament, creating an environment that
encourages greater preparation, discipline, and
ambition among participating teams. It also
provides an opportunity to enhance the overall
quality of the tournament experience, from
sporting organization and hospitality to
communication and event execution, ensuring
that FOF continues developing in line with higher
professional expectations.
Beyond this year’s edition, hosting Paris Saint-
Germain represents an opportunity for long-term
growth, stronger international partnerships, and
increased brand recognition. This milestone
strengthens FOF’s vision of creating a tournament
that connects football communities, inspires
players, and delivers meaningful experiences for
teams, partners, and audiences. It is a step
toward building a more competitive, prestigious,
and internationally recognized football event with
a lasting impact on the future of FOF.
GENERAL
INFORMATION
Future of Football is the largest Balkan tournament held in Albania — a
unique regional event that brings together football, talent, and passion
on one stage. Football holds a strong and meaningful place in Albanian-
speaking society, widely followed as a powerful platform that contributes
to social development and unity.
It is exactly this spirit and passion that we aim to share with teams and
athletes from all across the Balkans, creating an unforgettable
experience both on and off the field.
01
02
OBJECTIVES:
To develop and promote football by creating opportunities for
the exposure of young talents and strengthening sports
cooperation in the region. The tournament also aims to be
organized several times throughout the calendar year as a
sustainable development platform.
TEAMS & PARTICIAPATION
It includes teams and players from different age groups, both
from professional and amateur football, creating a competitive
and dynamic mix from various countries across the Balkans
and beyond.
03

unforgettable experience for players, coaches, and fans.

AGENDA:
The match schedule for the tournament has been
designed with a fully professional approach,
focusing on organization, functionality, and the
well-being of all participants.
Our goal is to create a high-quality sporting
experience where on-field performance goes
hand in hand with careful off-field organization. In
this way, every team and every player has the
opportunity to give their maximum in optimal
conditions throughout the entire tournament.
FIRST DAY:
GROUP STAGE MATCHES.
The tournament begins with the group
stage, where teams start their
competition and set the pace of the
competition.
SECOND DAY:
GROUP STAGE MATCHES.
Continuation of the group stage, where
the teams that qualify for the final phase
are determined.
THIRD DAY:
GROUP STAGE PLAYOFFS; FINALS – CUPS
The final matches, where the
winners of the tournament in each
category are declared.

GENERAL ACCREDITATION PROCEDURES:
The first day is MANDATORY for all teams to arrive at the designated pitch at the scheduled time for the accreditation procedure and membership check. You must present:
Players, staff, and managers (full team)
Identity documents
Any authorization for loaned players, including a copy of their membership card (final or provisional)
During accreditation, you will receive the MATI SPORT folder containing all tournament documentation and the official list of players approved by the organization. Before each match, you
must present the referee with this list, including the players who will take part on the field.
Each team must also be equipped with its own warm-up balls.
IMPORTANT:
1.It is mandatory for players and team officials to present an identity document before each match; otherwise, the game will be forfeited with a 0–3 result.
2.Accepted valid documents include a valid national ID card or passport. Every player is required to wear shin guards (protective gear); otherwise, they will not be authorized by the
match director to enter the field.
3.SUBSTITUTIONS: U14, U15 - UP TO 7 replacements, U11, U13, U9,
- UNLIMITED
4.CARDS: In case of a second yellow card in the same match or a direct red card, the player or manager is suspended for the following match. If a player or official is involved in violent or
offensive behavior towards referees or the organization, they may be disqualified for the entire tournament. If a player or official refuses to leave the field within 5 minutes, the team will
forfeit the match 0–3.
5.Appeals will only be accepted if submitted in written form with proper documentation within 30 minutes after the match ends.
6.BENCH AREA: Only 3 staff members per team are allowed on the bench. Each must hold the official technical pass issued at accreditation. The organization may authorize additional
staff access if properly accredited.
GENERAL INFORMATION:
1.All match results, provisional standings after the group stage, and knockout fixtures will be available on MATISPORT EVENTS under the Tournament section, as well as on the official
Facebook and Instagram pages FUTURE OF FOOTBALL.
2.Group standings and knockout brackets will also be published on MATISPORT EVENTS and the official social media pages.
3.Referees are not responsible for verifying compliance with tournament regulations; any discrepancies may be subject to an appeal reviewed by the tournament management and
possibly the sports judge.
4.All participating teams are required to respect proper conduct and adhere to the regulations of the Albanian Football Federation. All players must be officially registered with their
team, and confirmation (“OK”) from their national football federation must be submitted in order to participate in the tournament.
GENERAL ACCREDITATION PROCEDURES:
LOANED PLAYERS: The use of loaned players is allowed, with a maximum of 3 (three) per team for the entire duration of the tournament, upon presentation of a valid authorization issued
by the parent club. Loaning players between participating teams of the tournament is not permitted.
PLAYER LIST: Participating teams must submit their official player list to the tournament organization before the start of the competition. After submission, no changes are allowed. Before
each match, the team manager must present this list to the referee, including only the approved players (any other players will be removed from eligibility for that match).
MATCH DURATION:
2x25 - U14, U15; 2x20 - U11, U13; 2x15 - U9
TOURNAMENT FORMAT (U9, U11, U13, U14, U15,): Teams will be divided into groups of 4. At the end of the group stage, the teams ranked first and second will advance to the Play-Off phase.
RANKING: Points system is as follows: 3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, 0 points for a loss. In case of equal points, the following criteria apply:
1.Points obtained
2.Head-to-head result
3.Goal difference
4.Goals scored
5.Disciplinary ranking
6.Draw
NUMBER OF PLAYERS:
U9: 5+1; U11: 8+1; U13, U14, U15: 10+1
U13 – Offside Rule: The offside rule applies from one penalty area to the other (box-to-box), meaning from one goalkeeper’s penalty area to the opposing goalkeeper’s penalty area.
QUALIFICATION: In case of a draw in knockout stages, the match is decided by penalty shootout (5 penalties per team).
EXTRA TIME: No extra time is played.
TOURNAMENT MANAGEMENT: A tournament committee will be established (contact: +355 69 22 92 760), responsible for any disputes, protests, complaints, or unforeseen circumstances.
The committee will not accept protests against refereeing decisions and may report cases of unsporting behavior to the relevant national or international federation.
DISCIPLINE: Tournament discipline is under the authority of the sports judge.
SANCTIONS: Automatic sanctions apply as follows: a player sent off during a match will be suspended for the next match, unless further penalties are imposed by the tournament
management or sports judge. Yellow cards are reset after each match, except in cases of repeated or severe incidents reported by match officials.
APPEALS: Any appeal must be submitted within 30 minutes after the match, accompanied by a fee of €0. A copy must also be delivered to the opposing team within the same timeframe.
INSURANCE: Each participating team is responsible for providing insurance coverage for its players. The tournament organization ensures compliance with insurance requirements.
